Note the inspection status and the date of the next retest. 7. Include the contact information of the test company and the inspector's signature.

Advantages of a properly documented PAT Testing report

A well-structured PAT Testing report can bring numerous benefits: * Ensures compliance with safety regulations. * Facilitates easy tracking of test histories. * Enhances professional credibility. * Supports in identifying equipment defects proactively.

Possible improvements to the layout

To further optimize the PAT Testing report, consider adding: * A barcoded system for easy digital scanning. * Digital templates for effortless documentation. * Columns for the identification of residual faults.

Comparison of different types of PAT Testing reports
